ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago) is 'a good', «личность» (lichnost') 'personality', and «плотская смерть» (plotskaya smert') 'fleshly death'; «особенное отношение к миру» (osobennoye otnosheniye k miru) is 'particular relation to the world', and Tolstoy's italic «я» (ya, 'I') stays italic. «А этого-то и нет» (A etogo-to i net, 'and this is just what is not so') is restored where the website draft had 'But no such proof has been given'.
